text: What if you lived like the immortal jellyfish?
It's smaller than your pinky fingernail.
But it has a real superpower.
When it gets old or hurt...
and shrinks into a tiny blob.
Then it grows back into a baby!
That baby buds brand new jellyfish.
Again and again. Over and over.
One lab saw ten restarts in two years.
Now imagine YOU had that power.
You turn eighty... and feel tired.
You curl up in a cocoon...
and pop out as a kid again!
Normal human: one life. You: endless restarts.
Would you keep your memories? Nobody knows.
But in the wild, most still get eaten by fish.
So... would you restart your life?
